project_brief.title: Real-time Chat Application
project_brief.description: Build a full-featured real-time chat app with WebSocket communication, user authentication, and message persistence. The app will support one-on-one and group chats, typing indicators, and push notifications.
key_features: User registration and login with Firebase Auth
Real-time messaging via WebSocket (Starscream or URLSessionWebSocketTask)
Typing indicators and online status
Message history with Core Data offline caching
Push notifications for new messages

all_proposals.title: Live Sports Scoreboard
all_proposals.description: Build an app that displays live sports scores using a public WebSocket API (e.g., from TheSportsDB or similar). The app will show real-time updates for multiple sports, with offline caching and a clean, animated UI.
key_features: WebSocket connection management with automatic reconnection
Realtime score updates for multiple sports (e.g., football, basketball, soccer)
Offline score caching using Core Data
Simple, animated UI with score changes highlighted
Team and league selection

all_proposals.title: Collaborative Whiteboard
all_proposals.description: Build a real-time collaborative whiteboard app where multiple users can draw simultaneously. Uses WebSocket for synchronization and PencilKit for drawing. Includes session management, undo/redo, and user presence.
key_features: Real-time drawing synchronization across devices via WebSocket
Multiple color and brush size options using PencilKit
Undo/Redo functionality
User presence indicators (who is drawing)
Session creation and joining with unique codes

concepts.name: Asynchronous Programming
concepts.description: Giới thiệu các kỹ thuật lập trình bất đồng bộ như callbacks, promises, hoặc async/await để xử lý các tác vụ tốn thời gian mà không chặn luồng chính.

learning_objectives.name: Asynchronous Programming - Create
learning_objectives.description: Người học có khả năng thiết kế luồng xử lý bất đồng bộ sử dụng async/await, callbacks, hoặc promises để thực hiện các tác vụ I/O mà không chặn luồng chính.

learning_objectives.name: Async Control Flow Design
learning_objectives.description: Người học có khả năng thiết kế luồng điều khiển bất đồng bộ: callback-based (continuation passing), Promise/Future chaining (then/catch), async/await (synchronous syntax, implicit promise), structured concurrency (task groups, cancellation).

learning_objectives.name: Swift: Fetch Data with async/await
learning_objectives.description: Người học có khả năng viết async function, gọi URLSession.shared.data(from:) với await, xử lý CancellationError.
